responsibility: This header is GCC’s local description of the HSA BRIG binary format. It defines the BRIG scalar typedefs, enums, and packed record layouts for module headers, sections, directives, instructions, and operands that the HSA code generator and BRIG emitter use when constructing binary output. Its responsibility is to provide the canonical in-compiler C/C++ representation of the BRIG 1.0.1 object format, distinct from the higher-level HSA IL classes and lowering logic in the surrounding HSA sources.
